title: Squeeze lemma for [0, ∞]-valued ratios as r decreases to 0
statement: Let f : R → [0, ∞] and g : R → R. Suppose that for every δ > 0, for all r in some right neighbourhood of 0 (a set in the filter 𝓝[>] 0), g(r) > 0 and ENNReal.ofReal((1-δ) g(r)) <= f(r) <= ENNReal.ofReal((1+δ) g(r)). Then f(r)/ENNReal.ofReal(g(r)) → 1 in [0, ∞] as r → 0 with r > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (g : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < g r ∧ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - δ) * g r) ≤ f r ∧ f r ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + δ) * g r)) → Tendsto (fun r => f r / ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
